documents.title: Support Triage Matrix (rev. 2026-06)
documents.content:
## How to triage
Classify the report, then apply the first rule below that matches. Rules are evaluated in order; the first match wins.

| # | Condition | Priority | Owning team |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Any report describing exposure of data across tenants or accounts, unauthorised access, or a suspected breach — at any customer tier | P0 | security |
| 2 | Enterprise-tier customer, service is unavailable or wholly unusable | P0 | engineering |
| 3 | Enterprise-tier customer, service is degraded but usable | P1 | engineering |
| 4 | Mid-market or SMB customer, service is unavailable or wholly unusable | P1 | engineering |
| 5 | Mid-market or SMB customer, service is degraded but usable | P2 | engineering |
| 6 | Any billing, invoicing, or payment discrepancy, at any tier | P3 | billing |
| 7 | Anything else, including how-to and configuration questions | P2 | support |

Rule 1 takes precedence over every tier-based rule. A cross-tenant data exposure is a P0 for the security team even when the tier rules would route it elsewhere.

## Customer tier
Tier is a property of the account in the CRM, not something to infer from the ticket text.

## Leave correct tickets alone
If a ticket already carries the priority and owning team the matrix produces, do not modify it. Re-saving a correct ticket creates noise in the audit log and re-notifies the owning team.

tickets.subject: API returning 503 on every request since 06:00 UTC
tickets.body: None of our integrations can reach the API. Every call returns 503. This started around 06:00 UTC and we are completely down — no clinician can pull records.

tickets.subject: Dashboard takes 40+ seconds to load
tickets.body: The main dashboard still loads, but it takes 40 to 60 seconds. Everything else works. It is slow rather than broken.

tickets.subject: Invoice 4471 appears to have been charged twice
tickets.body: We were billed 2,400.00 twice on 2026-07-28 for invoice 4471. Please refund the duplicate.

tickets.subject: CSV export contains rows belonging to another company
tickets.body: I exported our shipment report this morning and roughly 200 rows are not ours — they reference a different company's consignment numbers and customer names. Our own data appears intact and the product is otherwise working normally.

tickets.subject: Search is slow for our EU users
tickets.body: Search still returns results but takes 8 to 12 seconds for users in Frankfurt. US users are unaffected. Workable but painful.

tickets.subject: How do I add a second admin user?
tickets.body: We would like a second administrator on the account. Where is that setting?

tickets.subject: Purchase order number missing from July invoice
tickets.body: Our finance team needs PO 88213 printed on the July invoice before they can pay it.
